Audi Sport Team Phoenix: Founded by Ernst Moser. Based in Meuspath, next to the Nürburgring. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2006.
BMW Team RBM: Founded by Bart Mampaey. Based in Mechelen, Belgium. Has run BMWs in the DTM since 2012.
STIHL AMG-Mercedes: Run by HWA AG from Affalterbach. HWA builds and runs the Mercedes DTM cars. One of two HWA teams in 2013.
BMW Team Schnitzer: Based in Freilassing. Has raced BMWs since the 1960s. Bruno Spengler won the 2012 title with the team.
Audi Sport Team Abt Sportsline: Hans-Jürgen Abt's team from Kempten. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2000. Mattias Ekström won the title with the team in 2004 and 2007.
Euronics AMG-Mercedes: The second HWA AG team, entered as EURONICS/Thomas Sabo AMG-Mercedes. Gary Paffett won the 2005 title.
BMW Team MTEK: Ernest Knoors' team from the Netherlands. New to the DTM in 2013. Drivers are former Formula 1 driver Timo Glock and rookie Marco Wittmann.
Audi Sport Team Abt: The second Abt Sportsline team. Timo Scheider won the title in 2008 and 2009. Adrien Tambay is in his second DTM season.
stern AMG-Mercedes: Peter Mücke's team from Berlin. Runs Mercedes cars. Both drivers come from Formula 3.
BMW Team RMG: Stefan Reinhold's team from Andernach. Has run BMWs in the DTM since 2012. Martin Tomczyk won the 2011 title.
Audi Sport Team Rosberg: Keke Rosberg's team from Neustadt an der Weinstraße. First DTM season in 1995 with Opel. Raced Mercedes from 2000 to 2004 and Audi since 2006.
